2f01fbed0f479de8.description: About the Role Halliburton is seeking a Svc Supv I-Slickline to lead slickline services in Al Qatif and Al Khobar. This full-time position involves overseeing field operations, ensuring customer satisfaction, and maintaining compliance with safety and operational standards. The role is suited for individuals who are committed to innovation, professional growth, and leadership within the global energy industry. Key Responsibilities Lead a crew in providing slickline services, focusing on less complex operations within a defined geographic area. Ensure onsite customer satisfaction by consulting on products and services and promoting positive customer relations. Review job designs and confirm that all necessary equipment, including units, WPCE, and downhole tools, are prepared and correct for the job. Perform all job aspects in compliance with Halliburton Management System (HMS) processes. Apply technical knowledge to resolve unexpected situations and consult with the HES operations base as required. Conduct onsite emergency unit and equipment maintenance when necessary. Maintain assigned equipment properly and ensure adherence to all safety regulations and procedures. Coordinate with third parties whose activities may impact slickline job execution to ensure smooth operations. Train service operators and operator assistants in areas of expertise. Promote safety awareness and environmental consciousness, complying with all applicable health, safety, and environmental procedures. Conduct and document all Halliburton HSE activities at the well site, including site assessments, risk analyses, onsite safety meetings, and PPE use. Complete all well site and post-job paperwork accurately. Participate in post-job reviews with the supervisor. Actively contribute to the quality improvement process. Identify potential sales opportunities for additional HES products and services and communicate them to relevant personnel. Professional Development The successful candidate will be expected to continuously develop knowledge and skills to manage more complex or a broader range of HES offerings. This includes enhancing customer service, negotiation, and leadership capabilities. 2f2595de414b36f4.description: نبحث عن متخصص مبيعات متخصص في حلول البرمجيات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات لقطاع الأعمال (B2B) للانضمام إلى فريقنا الديناميكي. سيكون المرشح المثالي مسؤولاً عن تحديد فرص المبيعات الجديدة، وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. المهام الرئيسية: * تحديد العملاء المحتملين في قطاع الأعمال وتطوير استراتيجيات مبيعات فعالة. * تقديم عروض تفصيلية للحلول البرمجية وتكنولوجيا المعلومات للعملاء. * إدارة دورة المبيعات بالكامل من التواصل الأولي إلى إغلاق الصفقة. * بناء والحفاظ على علاقات قوية ومستدامة مع العملاء الحاليين والجدد. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الشهرية والربع سنوية والسنوية. * البقاء على اطلاع دائم بأحدث اتجاهات التكنولوجيا والبرمجيات في السوق.

2f0583b03f68b1f7.description: About the Role CEER is seeking a Parts Advisor to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role serves as the primary point of contact for parts retail and service customers, facilitating parts and accessories purchases. The Parts Advisor is responsible for processing sales transactions accurately and efficiently, while also supporting the service center's parts fulfillment to ensure a positive customer experience and contribute to retail sales targets. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Greet and assist walk-in parts retail customers, identifying correct parts and accessories based on customer and vehicle requirements. Process parts retail and service sales orders accurately in SAP, ensuring correct pricing, discounts, and invoicing in line with CEER commercial policy. Promote accessories and value-added parts/service offers to maximize basket size and support retail sales targets. Coordinate with Service Advisors and Technicians to fulfill parts requirements for scheduled and walk-in service jobs. Pick, verify, and issue parts against repair orders and work orders in a timely manner to minimize vehicle turnaround time. Follow up on back-ordered or unavailable parts and communicate expected availability to service teams and customers. Respond to customer inquiries regarding part availability, pricing, and compatibility. Handle first-line customer complaints related to parts sales and escalate complex issues to the Parts Operations Assistant Manager. Process returns, exchanges, and warranty claims according to established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Maintain accurate records of retail and service sales transactions and daily cash/counter stock reconciliation. Generate routine daily/weekly sales activity reports for the Parts Operations Assistant Manager. Support month-end stock and sales reconciliation activities. Adhere to CEER Aftersales SOPs & Policies requirements for all transactions and maintain a clean, organized, and safe parts retail/counter area. Experience and Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Proficiency in processing sales transactions accurately and efficiently. Familiarity with SAP for order processing is preferred. Ability to identify correct parts and accessories based on customer and vehicle requirements. Strong organizational skills for maintaining accurate records and managing stock. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic retail and service environment, requiring direct interaction with customers and collaboration with service teams. The Parts Advisor will work at the parts counter and within the service center to ensure efficient parts fulfillment.

2f48af26a8b96a6e.description: About Tata Consultancy Services Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting, and business solutions organization with over 50 years of experience partnering with global businesses in their transformation journeys. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive-powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology, and engineering services and solutions. The company operates with a Location Independent Agile™ delivery model and is part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, employing over 616,171 consultants across 53 countries. Role Overview: End User Computing (EUC) Engineer TCS is seeking an End User Computing (EUC) Engineer for Retail & Warehouse Support in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive technical support for EUC equipment and software across office, retail store, and warehouse environments. The engineer will be responsible for incident resolution, equipment installation, and coordination of support activities to ensure operational efficiency and adherence to service levels. Key Responsibilities Resolve incidents and problems related to EUC equipment and software, providing break/fix support, advice, and assistance to users in office, stores, and warehouses. Provide onsite support or dispatch support specialists as needed to ensure operational and technical support, meeting agreed service levels. Communicate service request and incident status updates to end users. Install and configure new equipment and software, including upgrades, in accordance with established standards and change management procedures. Coordinate, plan, and schedule IMACs (Install, Move, Add, Change) with relevant IT functions. Validate IMAC requests from users or the Service Desk for correctness and proper authorization. Communicate with users regarding any issues with IMAC-related service requests. Coordinate and communicate with designated personnel or third parties concerning scheduling and requirements to minimize business impact on users. Coordinate the scheduling and dispatching of appropriate technicians, including third-party vendors. Connect equipment to network facilities, such as LAN and WAN. Coordinate with third-party service and maintenance providers to maintain EUC equipment and software. Maintain standards for supported operating systems. Manage email clients, including access configuration and troubleshooting. Provide support for IM, Voice, Video, and Collaboration services (O365). Offer first-level and break/fix support for Back Office Servers, Network, WiFi, PoS, various printers (Thermal, Laser, MFPs, Barcode, Wireless, Sewoo, Pathfinder), PDTs, iPads/iPods, PCs connected to digital screens, warehouse telephones/PABX, ADSL, Verifone, and ISP coordination. Support Intranet and Remote Access Services. Manage Anti-Virus installations, configurations, services, and troubleshooting. Support device encryption, file services, and print services. Perform IMACD (Install, Move, Add, Change, Decommission) and Break/Fix tasks. Support new warehouse openings/closings/shifts, warehouse sale setups, and asset procurement (PR approval & documentation) for regular support and new projects. Manage and support Desktops, Laptops, VDIs, and accessories. Coordinate with vendors for printer and peripheral replacements/provisioning and allocation. Retire IT equipment belonging to stores. Configure printer drivers. Configure BO Servers, POS systems, Routers, Switches, Wi-Fi Access Points, PDTs/Pathfinders, LJ Printers/MFPs, and Thermal Printers. Configure Footfall systems, Bio-Metric Attendance, Single-Swipe on POS, Telephone PABX, and Phone Extensions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring onsite support across various retail and warehouse locations. The role involves coordination with internal IT functions, end users, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless IT operations.

2f10e4bae8d03bd3.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Project Engineer TL to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position responsible for the comprehensive management of transmission projects, from initial design through to final handover. The role requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in project engineering. Key Responsibilities Manage transmission projects from the base design stage through to final handover and acceptance, ensuring adherence to the scope of work, company standards, and specifications. Coordinate all activities related to electrical components within projects. Monitor project schedules and budgets, ensuring timely completion and financial control. Review and approve material submittals, shop drawings, and as-built drawings. Forward engineering transmittals to relevant SEC divisions as required. Prepare regular technical reports and monthly progress updates for the Project Manager. Develop detailed weekly programs for construction activities and prepare manpower/resource requirements to achieve project completion on schedule. Liaise with the construction/project manager, client, and subcontractors, and supervise allocated construction activities. Ensure compliance with project specifications to meet client satisfaction. Monitor daily operations, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards, tracking project budgets, and keeping deliverables on schedule using P6 Primavera. Required Experience Candidates for this Project Engineer TL position should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in managing transmission projects. Location and Work Type This is a full-time role based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The position involves working on site to oversee project execution and coordination.

2fdcc0613a9fbd6b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كرم الوطن عن فني زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والعلمي والمشورة في مجال الزراعة، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الاختبارات والتجارب اللازمة لدعم الإنتاج الزراعي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الاختبارات على عينات مثل الخلايا النباتية أو الأنسجة الحيوانية، وتحديد تأثيرات طرق الإنتاج المختلفة على النمو والعائد. اختبار جودة المنتجات الزراعية وتحديد الطفيليات أو الكائنات الضارة الأخرى. تفتيش المزارع وتقييم الظروف البيئية للنباتات والحيوانات، بما في ذلك الرطوبة والحرارة والنظافة. تقديم الدعم الفني والمشورة بخصوص تنفيذ إجراءات أو أساليب جديدة لزيادة الإنتاجية والعائد، والمساعدة في تطبيقها. تشغيل وصيانة المعدات البحثية المستخدمة لتحليل العينات وتحديد الكائنات الحية واختبار الجودة. دعم الأخصائيين الزراعيين والمزارعين في مهامهم. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الزراعة أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد للمبادئ الزراعية وتقنيات الإنتاج. القدرة على إجراء الاختبارات المعملية والميدانية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في الملاحظة. القدرة على تقديم المشورة الفنية بوضوح. مهارات تشغيل وصيانة المعدات المتخصصة. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة كرم الوطن. يتطلب العمل التواجد الميداني في المزارع والمختبرات لإجراء المهام المطلوبة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2f14f1ef223d49fa.description: About Mace Group Mace Group combines construction expertise with consultancy services, aiming to enhance project potential and redefine ambition. The company is currently providing strategic project management consultancy for significant new stadium builds, multiple stadium redevelopments, and wider precinct transformations in Riyadh. This scope includes delivering new stadiums, increasing existing stadium capacities, developing major mixed-use amenities, and implementing robust knowledge-transfer programs to ensure operational excellence and long-term sustainability beyond construction. The Role: FIFA Design Compliance Expert The FIFA Design Compliance Expert will join a dedicated team responsible for managing all FIFA and World Cup requirements throughout the design process for Stadium and Training site Programmes in Riyadh. This part-time role involves providing authoritative interpretation, design assurance, and strategic guidance from concept design through detailed design, technical approvals, and design freeze. The expert will collaborate closely with the client, World Cup Authority, FIFA, Lead Designers, specialist consultants, and programme teams to ensure that permanent works and planned overlay are coordinated, compliant, buildable, and aligned with operational, legacy, cost, and programmed objectives. Key Responsibilities Interface with FIFA, the World Cup Authority, and the client, contributing to design reviews, technical workshops, submissions, and approval meetings, and providing clear positions on compliance, design acceptability, derogations, and risks. Manage and maintain FIFA design requirements, compliance matrices, and design assurance plans, translating FIFA stadium standards and host requirements into clear briefs, criteria, and actions for all design disciplines. Review and challenge stadium designs from concept through detailed design to confirm compliance across various areas including field of play, seating bowl and sightlines, spectator circulation, accessibility, safety and security, broadcast, media, hospitality, team and official facilities, back-of-house areas, masterplan tournament mode design, logistics, transport interfaces, and fan experience. Establish design-stage compliance gateways and coordinate the preparation, quality assurance, and submission of design reports, drawings, schedules, dashboards, and evidence packs required for FIFA and authority reviews. Coordinate multidisciplinary design integration across architecture, structural engineering, MEP, ICT, security, fire and life safety, vertical transportation, landscape, wayfinding, acoustics, lighting, broadcast, and specialist venue systems, ensuring interfaces and spatial requirements are resolved before design freeze from a FIFA perspective. Coordinate permanent works with temporary and overlay requirements, identifying where provisions, capacities, routes, loadings, spaces, and connection points must be embedded in the base design to avoid late redesign or unnecessary long-term cost. Provide programme-wide design assurance across multiple stadiums and training facilities, reporting compliance status, design risks, departures, decisions, and mitigation actions, while promoting consistency and lessons learned across the venue portfolio. Advise client leadership and design teams on FIFA strategy, value engineering, design changes, approvals, and legacy outcomes, ensuring cost or programme decisions do not compromise mandatory compliance or venue functionality. Qualifications and Experience A degree in architecture, engineering, sports venue design, or a related discipline. Professional accreditation and FIFA-related credentials are desirable. Extensive design-stage experience on FIFA World Cup stadiums and training facilities, major football venues, or comparable international event venues, with involvement from concept design through detailed design and approvals. Proven experience interpreting FIFA stadium requirements and converting them into design briefs, compliance matrices, review comments, technical submissions, and coordinated design solutions. Strong technical understanding of stadium planning and design, including seating bowl geometry and sightlines, crowd movement, accessibility, safety and security, fire and life safety, broadcast and media, hospitality, player and official facilities, back-of-house operations, and overlay interfaces. Experience leading multidisciplinary design reviews and resolving interfaces between architecture, engineering, specialist venue systems, operational requirements, BIM coordination, and temporary event infrastructure. Programme-level experience providing design assurance across multiple stadiums, training sites, or sport venues, with the ability to manage compliance, risk, cost, programme, approvals, and legacy considerations. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the credibility to lead technical discussions, provide clear design direction, and constructively challenge consultants and senior stakeholders.

2f2b10e2b4f5c5b6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع البحر الأحمر الطبي عن فني تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقه في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الرعاية التمريضية الأساسية والشخصية للمرضى، والعمل تحت إشراف ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية آخر. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للممرضين وأخصائيي الرعاية الصحية الآخرين في تخطيط وإدارة رعاية المرضى. المساعدة في إعطاء الأدوية الموصوفة وإحالة المرضى إلى أخصائيي الرعاية الصحية عند الحاجة. مساعدة المرضى في النظافة الشخصية والأنشطة الأساسية مثل الاغتسال والحلاقة. المساعدة في الأنشطة اليومية مثل تناول الطعام والتمرينات، وتقديم الوجبات والمشروبات حسب خطط الرعاية. مساعدة المرضى في التنقل والالتفاف وتغيير الوضع، بالإضافة إلى مساعدتهم في دخول دورات المياه وأثناء الاستحمام. تطوير المعرفة والخبرة الحفاظ على الخبرة الفنية وتحديث المعارف بشكل مستمر. دراسة المنشورات المتخصصة والمشاركة في الدورات التدريبية والمؤتمرات ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمريض أو الرعاية الصحية ذات الصلة. القدرة على العمل تحت إشراف وتوجيه ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مجمع البحر الأحمر الطبي في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بتقديم رعاية عالية الجودة للمرضى ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه.

Drive sales promotion and territory performance for Dupixent, aiming to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets aligned with company strategy. 2fd8bd1e2ef705f2.company_name: مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات
2fd8bd1e2ef705f2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن مدرب رياضي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدريب الرياضي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية اكتشاف ميول اللاعبين ومواهبهم واستعداداتهم، وإعداد خطط لتنميتها وتعزيزها وتنفيذها. إعداد الخطط التدريبية قصيرة وطويلة الأمد، وتطويرها لتحديد عناصر اللياقة البدنية وتنميتها. تطوير المهارات الأساسية للعبة الرياضية التي يتم تدريب اللاعبين عليها، وتقييم أدائهم وتنمية مهاراتهم. إدارة المقابلات الرياضية، وتوجيه اللاعبين وتبديلهم وفقاً لمجريات المقابلة. تطبيق قانون وقواعد اللعبة ومتابعة تطورها بشكل مستمر. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدريب الرياضي. القدرة على اكتشاف وتطوير المواهب الرياضية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الخطط التدريبية وتقييم الأداء. معرفة عميقة بقوانين وقواعد اللعبة الرياضية وتطوراتها. بيئة العمل يعمل المدرب الرياضي ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بالحديثة، مما يتطلب الالتزام ببيئة عمل منظمة ومحددة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدن قرية العليا والقريات بمنطقة الجوف. تقديم التقارير يتولى المدرب مسؤولية إعداد وتقديم تقارير عمل دورية توثق تقدم اللاعبين والخطط التدريبية المنفذة، مع ضمان حفظ هذه التقارير بشكل دقيق ومنظم. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2f71f0e0327524bf.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Cook I to join our team in Medina, Al Madinah. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and involves preparing and cooking a variety of food items while adhering to quality and presentation standards. Key Responsibilities Prepare special meals or substitute items as required. Regulate the temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters to ensure proper cooking. Manage food thawing processes by pulling items from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portioning, arrangement, and garnishing of all food items. Maintain accurate food logs and monitor the quality and quantity of prepared food. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods and inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff about menu specials and out-of-stock items. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards in all tasks. Physical Requirements and Guest Service Anticipate and address guests’ service needs with professionalism. Communicate with others using clear and professional language. Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Capable of reaching overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. 2f61c0d35ee46496.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Legal Senior Researcher to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will contribute to achieving milestones and operational targets within the assigned functional area. Role Purpose This position focuses on undertaking operational legal activities, including conducting comprehensive legal research and preparing legal studies for committees. These studies will primarily relate to fines and customs assessments imposed by ZATCA. A key responsibility will be ensuring the completeness and accuracy of data within legal files. Key Responsibilities Draft ZATCA legal lawsuit management policies, guidelines, and standard model forms. Assist in identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of legal systems, processes, and practices through research of global best practices and trends. Develop relevant templates for lawsuit management services across all ZATCA functions. Support the development of negotiating strategies in conjunction with internal stakeholders for effective legal case management. Manage the continuous update of lawsuit management database systems, ensuring request logs are current. Conduct preliminary evaluations to assist in determining the severity and urgency of litigation cases against ZATCA. Assist in representing ZATCA before judicial bodies, committees, and governmental authorities in cases for or against the authority, ensuring all necessary supporting documents are available. Prepare settlements for negotiation with employees and external entities involved in lawsuits against ZATCA (excluding audit and collection-related settlements). Archive judgments from lawsuits won by ZATCA for future reference. Identify outsourced legal experts to provide additional legal advice for managing internal and external non-tax, zakat, and customs litigation cases. Adhere to all relevant policies, processes, and standard operating procedures to ensure consistent work execution. Support junior team members in resolving escalated problems and provide necessary assistance for efficient work completion. Escalate complex problems to the appropriate personnel to ensure proper resolution of cases and issues. The role operates within a structured environment, requiring adherence to established guidelines and procedures while allowing for independent work under minimal supervision.

2f95ce8623ad7a9e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ياسر احمد العقبي للاستشارات المهنية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات والإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. هذه فرصة للمهندسين المعماريين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة للعمل بدوام كامل في بيئة مهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الملحقات أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم المشورة المتخصصة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار الموقع المناسب للمشاريع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين واختيار المواد المناسبة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة. معرفة بأسس ترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. مهارات في إعداد الرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق في شركة ياسر احمد العقبي للاستشارات المهنية بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف على المشاريع. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. المدينة: جدة. نوع العمل: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

2ff3cdbc2b2c0148.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة الهدف الامني للمقاولات العامة عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى حارس الأمن مسؤولية حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام داخل أماكن العمل، من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل لمراقبة الممتلكات ضد السرقة والتخريب. مراقبة منافذ الدخول والخروج من المنشأة وإعطاء التصاريح اللازمة. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. تفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان إحكام إغلاقها وتأمينها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح المعمول بها في المنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث المبلغ عنها. الاتصال بإدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في المؤسسة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأمن أو ما شابه. القدرة على العمل بفعالية في بيئة تتطلب اليقظة والانتباه للتفاصيل. الالتزام بالتعليمات والقدرة على تطبيق الإجراءات الأمنية. متطلبات العمل القدرة على القيام بدوريات ومراقبة الأماكن لفترات طويلة. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع الموظفين والزوار. القدرة على الاستجابة السريعة والفعالة في حالات الطوارئ. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق أمني لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومنظمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة.

2f2129f6d86cabf5.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Storekeeper to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time position involves managing the receipt, organization, and distribution of goods within the hotel's operations. The role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Receive and organize goods by department, ensuring correct warehouse placement and timely delivery to relevant departments. Stack received goods efficiently on pallets or trolleys. Complete order forms for inventory and supply management. Notify management promptly in case of stock depletion. Receive deliveries, properly store perishables, and manage stock rotation. Verify deliveries for freshness, cleanliness, conformity, and batch quality. Refuse damaged, non-compliant, or incorrect items. Operational Duties Adhere to sanitary rules and handling procedures in all food-related areas. Organize, clean, and disinfect refrigerators, freezers, floors, equipment, and pipes. Remove empty pallets, cartons, and waste, placing them in appropriate storage areas. Compliance and Professional Conduct Report accidents, injuries, and dangerous working conditions to the manager; comply with training and obtain required safety certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures, ensuring a clean and complete work uniform and maintaining a professional appearance. Maintain confidentiality regarding brand and hotel-specific information and protect company property. Use clear, courteous, and professional language with guests and colleagues. Develop positive and constructive professional relationships with peers to achieve common goals. Comply with quality requirements and standards. Ability to move, lift, or carry loads weighing up to 23 kilograms. Comfortable working standing, sitting, and being in motion for extended periods. Additional Duties Perform all other tasks requested by managers that are consistent with the position's scope.

2f58623f14272b06.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التاج المضيئ للمقاولات عن أخصائي زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير الأساليب الزراعية لزيادة الكفاءة الإنتاجية، وإعداد برامج الري والتسميد ومكافحة الآفات الزراعية، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الاحتياجات البيئية لزراعة المحاصيل والخضراوات وبساتين أشجار الفاكهة، وتقييم جدوى زراعتها. إعداد برامج تحضير الأرض للزراعة، واختيار النمط الزراعي المناسب، وتنظيم الدورة الزراعية. تطوير الأساليب الزراعية بهدف رفع الكفاءة الإنتاجية للمحاصيل. إعداد برامج الري والتسميد ومكافحة الآفات الزراعية والحصاد، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. متابعة إجراءات تجهيز المنتجات الزراعية لعمليات ما بعد الحصاد، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال الزراعية، وعرضها وحفظها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في المجال الزراعي. القدرة على دراسة الاحتياجات البيئية للمحاصيل وتقييم جدوى الزراعة. معرفة بأساليب إعداد برامج الري والتسميد ومكافحة الآفات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة التاج المضيئ للمقاولات في مدينة بريدة بمنطقة القصيم. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

2f622d83d487094f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايوان للحراسات الأمنية عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام من خلال المراقبة الدورية لمواقع العمل ومنافذ الدخول، مع التركيز على منع السرقة والتخريب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول والخروج من المنشأة، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. التجول بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في المنشأة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الحراسات الأمنية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وفي بيئة تتطلب اليقظة والانتباه. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن في مدينة الرياض ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالمهام الأمنية على مدار الساعة، مع التركيز على تطبيق الإجراءات الوقائية لضمان سلامة الممتلكات والأفراد. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة ايوان للحراسات الأمنية.

2f650289142ea299.job_title: Biomedical Engineer - Saudi Nationals - Al Khobar
2f650289142ea299.description: As a biomedical engineer you will be expected to be Performing quality technical calls and services for Imdad's clients and to provide them with the needed technical support through installation, adjustment, maintenance, and repair of the biomedical equipments. Minimum scoring of 80% in Imdad’s Technical exam. Bilingual (Arabic, and English) is a must. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. 2f7e52563cd77c4b.description: Job description Overview & Responsibilities The Senior Application Engineer serves as a technical authority and strategic commercial partner within the rotating equipment and turbomachinery manufacturing sector. This role is responsible for leading the design, proposal development, and commercial execution of mission-critical centrifugal machinery including compressors, steam turbines, expanders, and pumps—for major global clients across Petrochemical, LNG, and emerging Clean Energy markets. Position Purpose Serve as a technical subject matter expert in the application and system integration of centrifugal rotating equipment, including centrifugal compressors, steam turbines, expanders, and pumps. Architect and deliver competitive, high-reliability technical proposals and engineered-to-order solutions tailored to client specifications across the Petrochemical, LNG, and Sustainability markets. Deliver joint technical and commercial leadership to expand market share, support sales pursuits, and advance key strategic business initiatives. 2fae19520c6683c0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة المنصة التقنية لصيانة السيارات عن مدير خدمة العملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أعمال قسم خدمة العملاء، مع تطوير معايير الخدمة لضمان تلبية احتياجات العملاء وتوقعاتهم. يتولى مدير خدمة العملاء أيضاً إدارة الاستعلامات التي يتم تصعيدها بشكل مباشر. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة قسم خدمة العملاء داخل المنشأة بشكل فعال. وضع سياسات ومعايير خدمة العملاء والإشراف على تنفيذها لضمان جودة الخدمة. تحليل مصادر المشكلات المتكررة في مجال خدمة العملاء، وتحديد الحلول المحتملة، وتنسيق الموارد لتحسين الخدمات. التعامل مع شكاوى أو استعلامات العملاء التي يتم تصعيدها، وإصدار أوامر المساعدة، أو إعادة المبالغ المدفوعة، أو صرف التعويضات، أو الإجراءات التصحيحية الأخرى حسب الحاجة. توجيه فريق خدمة العملاء لتقديم المساعدة والمشورة للعملاء بكفاءة. الإشراف على إعداد وتنفيذ استبيانات قياس مستوى رضا العملاء، وجمع الإحصاءات الخاصة بخدمة العملاء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال خدمة العملاء أو إدارة العمليات ذات الصلة. القدرة على وضع وتطبيق سياسات ومعايير خدمة العملاء. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المشكلات وتقديم الحلول. مهارات قيادية وتوجيهية لفريق العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل التفاعل المباشر مع فريق خدمة العملاء والعملاء لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة. سيتم الإفصاح عن تفاصيل الراتب خلال عملية المقابلة.

2fdc4c53a151e7d7.description: About the Role DXC Technology is seeking an experienced Digital Infrastructure Lead to provide leadership and governance across enterprise infrastructure services. This full-time senior leadership position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on Cloud & Compute, Network & Network Security Operations, and Security Systems Support. The role is responsible for overall service performance, operational stability, governance, stakeholder management, risk management, and continuous improvement across multiple infrastructure functions. Key Responsibilities Provide overall leadership and governance across Cloud & Compute, Network & Network Security, and Security Systems Support. Lead and develop functional leads and technical managers responsible for day-to-day infrastructure operations. Establish clear priorities, responsibilities, KPIs, and service-performance expectations across infrastructure functions. Ensure effective collaboration and coordination between infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, service management, vendors, and other technology teams. Monitor infrastructure risks, dependencies, capacity, resilience, and service continuity. Drive a strong culture of accountability, service excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Oversee services covering servers, operating systems, virtualization, containers, storage, backup, databases, and related infrastructure technologies. Ensure network availability, performance, resilience, capacity, security, and configuration integrity for LAN/WAN, wireless networks, connectivity, remote access, firewalls, and load balancing. Provide leadership oversight for operational support of enterprise security systems and platforms, including incident investigation, troubleshooting, and problem management. Ensure infrastructure services are delivered in accordance with established service levels, processes, security requirements, and IT service-management standards. Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams, service providers, and vendors. Act as a senior escalation point for infrastructure-related service performance, risks, and operational issues. Develop consolidated infrastructure performance and operational reports, tracking KPIs, service levels, and improvement initiatives. The Digital Infrastructure Lead will provide direction to functional leads and technical managers, ensuring infrastructure services are secure, resilient, reliable, and aligned with business and operational requirements. The successful candidate must possess sufficient technical knowledge to challenge recommendations, understand risks and dependencies, support decision-making, and communicate complex infrastructure matters effectively to senior stakeholders. 2ff3e79852a5e10f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فندق تيم الفندقية عن موظف استقبال فندق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على خدمات الضيوف في مكتب الاستقبال وتنسيقها وتقديمها، بما في ذلك عمليات الحجز وتسجيل الدخول والخروج لضمان تجربة سلسة للنزلاء. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الحفاظ على قائمة الحجوزات وتوفير السجلات الورقية الضرورية. العمل على رفع مستوى خدمة العملاء ورضاهم، ومتابعة المنازعات والشكاوى وحلها. ضمان تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات الفندق بشكل فعال. تكوين علاقات تجارية قوية والحفاظ عليها مع الأطراف الأخرى، مثل وكالات السفر والحجوزات. مراجعة أسعار الفندق وتنظيم الفواتير تبعاً لذلك. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة مهام مكتب الاستقبال بكفاءة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لخدمة الضيوف والتعامل مع الشركاء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في الرياض. سيعمل موظف الاستقبال ضمن فريق الفندق لضمان تقديم أفضل مستوى من الخدمة للضيوف. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فندق تيم الفندقية، يرجى تقديم طلبكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

2ffb4578d02373b2.description: Job description Company Description John Crane, a business of Smiths Group, is a global leader in mission-critical flow control solutions for energy and process industries that enable efficient and sustainable operations. Our products include mechanical seals and systems, couplings, filtration systems, and predictive digital monitoring technologies. We have a global network of more than 200 sites in over 50 countries and employ more than 6,000 people worldwide. We partner with our customers to help them keep their operations safe, reduce downtime, improve efficiency, and meet the latest environmental standards. John Crane is part of Smiths Group. For over 170 years, Smiths has been pioneering progress by engineering for a better future. We serve millions of people every year, helping to create a safer, more efficient, productive, and better-connected world across four global markets: energy, security & defence, space & aerospace, and general industrial. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, Smiths employs approximately 16,000 colleagues in over 50 countries. Job Description SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: The Reliability Engineer will provide on-site support to external customers by conducting failure analyses and reliability assessments of rotating equipment, with a particular focus on sealing systems. The role involves identifying performance and reliability improvement opportunities, troubleshooting equipment issues, and conducting root cause analyses (RCA) using established methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, Ishikawa (Fishbone) Diagrams, Apollo RCA, and other structured problem-solving techniques. The position also includes providing on-site technical support for John Crane products, supporting customer maintenance activities, and assisting with the installation, dismantling, inspection, and assembly of mechanical seals and related equipment. SPECIFIC DUTIES, ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO : Perform reliability analyses of customer rotating equipment, with a focus on sealing system performance and optimization. Lead and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations involving sealing systems and rotating equipment, including site assessments, data collection, analysis, reporting, and presentation of findings and recommendations to customers. Conduct field troubleshooting activities, including problem diagnosis, development of corrective actions, and implementation of appropriate solutions in collaboration with customer teams. Deliver detailed technical presentations and recommendations to customers to support reliability improvement initiatives, sales opportunities, and RCA activities. Support customer sites with equipment measurements, seal installation, commissioning, and technical inspections. Ensure all work is performed in accordance with John Crane standards, procedures, quality requirements, and safety policies. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships through effective technical support and professional communication. Qualifications EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum of 5 years of experience in rotating equipment and sealing systems, with a strong focus on maintenance, reliability, and asset performance improvement. Solid understanding of industrial plant operations and maintenance environments, including work management systems, turnaround planning, maintenance planning, and scheduling processes. Experience working in a proactive, multinational, and multicultural environment. Strong technical knowledge of rotating equipment reliability principles and maintenance best practices. Knowledge of the John Crane product portfolio is considered an advantage. Professional certifications such as Vibration Analysis, Machinery Lubrication, Thermography, Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE), or Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) are highly desirable. Fluency in English is required; Arabic language skills are an advantage. Additional Information With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity. Across our company, we recognize excellence, culminating in the Smiths Excellence Awards, our annual celebration of the most extraordinary activities, people, and projects that best showcase our strengths and help drive our business forward. We announce these on our annual Smiths Day, a global celebration of Smiths around our network. Join us for a great career with competitive compensation and benefits, while helping engineer a better future. We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity. At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Group, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. Avoid fraudulent requests by applying jobs directly through our career’s website (Careers - Smiths Group plc) Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

2f884c33c94137ed.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع فيصل تبوك لطب الاسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في تبوك. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، ويقدم فرصة للعمل بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة مهنية متخصصة في رعاية صحة الفم والأسنان. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة، وتحليلها لتشخيص الحالات المرضية للفم والأسنان. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع احتياجات كل مريض. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للحالات المرضية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات المستمرة في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بطب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص وعلاج مجموعة واسعة من حالات الأسنان والفم. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية الصحية بفعالية. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً بتقديم رعاية أسنان عالية الجودة ضمن بيئة عيادة حديثة ومجهزة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

2ff224f40dfc7043.description: Job description About the role We are hiring an Assistant Vice President (AVP) to lead end‑to‑end post‑trade custody operations in Saudi Arabia , spanning clearing & settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions/income, reconciliations, and client onboarding / account set‑up – Sunday to Thursday . You will drive service excellence , strong risk & control discipline , and regulatory adherence across the KSA post‑trade ecosystem: trading on Saudi Exchange , clearing via Muqassa (CCP) , and depository/settlement via Edaa , with settlement cash movements supported through SAMA . Why this role is important to us State Street is one of the world’s largest global custodians, with over USD 51.7 trillion in AUC/A , and is executing a growth strategy that includes expanding direct market presence. As part of this strategy, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) is a priority market , supported by Vision 2030 reforms , increasing foreign participation, and strong institutional demand. This role is critical to: Enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering strong, controlled post‑trade operations aligned to local market infrastructure and rules. Ensuring a high-quality client experience through timely settlement, strong exception management, and robust controls as KSA market activity expands. Supporting the firm’s ability to deepen relationships with key institutional clients as the market evolves. Key responsibilities (KSA market aligned) 1) Clearing & Settlement (Equities, ETFs, Sukuk/Bonds) Own daily settlement processing for Saudi Exchange trades, settling at Edaa in line with market cycle (standard T+2 ; negotiated deals T+0 to T+5 , where applicable). Reconcile and validate client instructions, broker confirmations and Muqassa clearing outcomes; proactively resolve exceptions and breaks. Monitor fails, manage aged items, and coordinate remediation per Muqassa fails management processes and local cut‑offs. Manage instruction lifecycle (amend/cancel/partial handling where permitted) and maintain robust STP and control checks. 2) Cash & Funding (DvP / SAMA-linked settlement) Ensure funding readiness for DvP settlement and oversee cash settlement processing and reconciliations. (KSA market practice: securities settle gross; cash settles net via SAMA-linked settlement accounts ). Investigate and clear cash breaks within cut‑offs; escalate time‑critical issues with clear impact articulation. 3) FX Operations (Operational Support) Support FX activities required for settlement and client cash needs (confirmations, value dates, SSIs); drive timeliness and exception reduction. 4) Corporate Actions, Dividends & Income Manage end‑to‑end asset servicing: event capture, entitlement validation, booking/posting, reconciliations, and issue resolution with internal partners and vendors. 5) Client Onboarding / Account Set‑Up (Edaa structures) Lead operational onboarding to ensure accounts are set up correctly to be settlement‑ready (including Edaa account structures and investor identifiers required for local processing). Partner with Client Service, Compliance/KYC and market counterparts to deliver smooth go‑lives and operational readiness. 6) Controls, Governance & Audit Readiness Own daily controls, reconciliations, evidence retention and audit‑ready documentation; support internal/external audits and risk assessments. Maintain strong messaging discipline and operational risk management; experience with SWIFT MT and exposure to ISO 20022 MX preferred. 7) Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead and develop a small‑to‑mid sized operations team; set objectives, coach performance and build cross‑coverage/skills resilience. Act as an escalation point and trusted partner for brokers, custodians, market infrastructures, correspondent banking partners and internal stakeholders (Ops, Risk, Technology, Client). Drive continuous improvement, automation, and standardization aligned to regional and global operating model. Operational analytics & reporting (streamlined) Build and own KPI/MIS for post‑trade performance (e.g., STP , settlement timeliness, fail rate, aged breaks, cash funding accuracy, FX confirmation timeliness, corporate action accuracy, reconciliation break rate). Produce daily dashboards and monthly senior management packs (trends, root cause, remediation plan, automation pipeline). Run capacity/utilization and coverage planning aligned to local market operating days ( Sunday–Thursday coverage considerations). Qualifications & experience Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or related discipline (Master’s/MBA preferred). 10–12 years ’ experience across settlement, custody operations, corporate actions, FX operations and reconciliations; 3+ years people management experience (KSA / Middle East experience strongly preferred). Strong knowledge of post‑trade risk & controls, exception management and stakeholder communication. Working knowledge of SWIFT (and market messaging); familiarity with Bloomberg/Refinitiv and corporate actions platforms advantageous. #LI About State Street Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. 2f8e485b54a99902.description: Job description Company Description Accor have more than 300,000 hospitality experts placing people at the heart of what we do, creating emotion for our guests, and nurturing passion for service and achievement beyond limits. Building on the strength of our teams and of our integrated ecosystem of leading brands, personalized services and expert solutions, we break new ground to reimagine hospitality and inspire new ways to experience the world. Job Description PRIMARY OBJECTIVE OF POSITION Provide a professional, advisory and executive support service to all department heads and hotel staff to achieve the strategic goals of the establishment. TASKS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES - To adhere to all personnel policies and procedures - To assist in the control and monitoring of all recruitment for the hotel and all induction procedures to company standard - To help ensure that all staff welfare aspects meet the agreed standards, including all aspects of staff communication. RECRUITMENT AND SELECTION - Coordinate the screening of all applicants - Follow the hotel standard procedures for the appointment of selected personnel - Assist in managing the hotel's "talent bank" to allow for replacement/supplementing of existing staff. - Assist in the production and co-ordination of advertising - Co-ordinate salary survey in-conjunction - Assist with recruitment open days and fairs TRAINING & DEVELOPMENT: - Co-ordinate room reservations for training courses and ensure adequate notification - Assist with the administration of the hotel orientation of new staff occur prior to the actual commencement of work and on the actual orientation day - Assist in the formulation of Human Resources training plan - Assist in developing and maintaining an appropriate skills base - Develop individual training programmers for staff according to job requirements with a view to multi-skilling staff - Continually review progress in training by implementing appropriate assessment procedures - Assist department heads in maintaining current knowledge and understanding of contemporary Human Resource Issues - Assist in checking weekly training sheets from all departments to ensure all staff receive daily and weekly task training via their Head of Department. - Wherever required, support the HOD in the provision of task training in a hands-on manner - Conduct health & safety training with new starters as required - Assist in maintaining an up-to-date record of training requirements for personnel within the hotel. - Ensure that staff appraisals take place on regular basis by the use of a monitoring system - Set up systems to monitor achievement of departmental goals and objectives - In conjunction with the Safety/ Security Manager assist in the development of departmental health & safety training files. Assist and advise heads of department on health & safety training. STAFF WELFARE - Assist in ensuring that staff welfare programmes, including staff-room, uniforms, name badges, etc. is maintained. Monitor all staff notice boards to ensure that they are up-to-date and of interest and relevance. - Monitor staff suggestion box and co-ordinate replies as appropriate - Assist in the counseling of staff to help prevent work related problems - Assist in dispute resolution - Conduct exit interviews as appropriate - Provide staff details as requested by the accounts department on a monthly basis, in order that labour turnover and equal opportunities maybe monitored - Assist with staff accommodation arrangements as appropriate - Be aware of, and where possible deal with the day to day industrial relations and inform and advise Human Resource Manager of any potential problems and/or solutions. - Co-ordinate pension/medical/committee meetings ensuring room is booked and staff are notified. - Co-ordinate administration for Employee of the Month and Employee of the Year scheme. PERSONNEL - Be aware of Human Resource Auditing Procedures and assist in achieving the objectives/completing, and to monitor the branch staff turnover, absenteeism, guest reaction and labour cost - Advise on all local labour law issues - Maintain relationship with appropriate authorities to ensure kept up to date on changes to regulations and opportunities to provide input - Ensure the standards of ”best practice” are developed and encourage line management commitment to their implementation ADMINISTRATION - Ensure all personnel records (both computerized and manual) are maintained accurately and securely. - Prepare and maintain files, reports, letters, memorandums and other relevant business documentation. - Assist in the day to day administration of the department, ensuring reference checks are made, contracts & offers are prepared, regret letters etc are sent out in a timely fashion OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES - Purchase stock/inventory according to purchasing procedures and specification - Abide by both the hotel and Radisson SAS policies and procedures - Control the security of company's stock and property. - To comply with any reasonable request of Human Resource Manager / Senior Management. - All staff of the company are required to make themselves available for training and - Communication meetings for which advance notice will normally be given. - PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL: In the interests of helping staff maintain high quality standards of service, identifying training needs and assisting in the personal development of employees, all personnel are given an annual appraisal interview. Qualifications Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Working understanding of human resource principles, practices and procedures. HR experience. Communication skills. Onboarding management. Being detail oriented. Microsoft Office. Compliance. Customer service. Recruiting. Collaboration. Additional Information In addition to recruiting and placing new employees, an HR Coordinator assists with guiding employees through various human resource processes, answering any questions they may have about policies. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

2f17969b7c03349c.description: About Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE) Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE), a subsidiary of Red Sea Global (RSG), is responsible for the design and delivery of land and marine experiences at The Red Sea destination. RSSE manages and operates a diverse portfolio of sports, adventure, and leisure offerings, including water sports through Galaxea, adventure activities via Akun, and leisure experiences delivered by WAMA. Role Summary The Water Sport Instructor is a full-time, site-based role responsible for the safe and professional delivery of water sports activities. This position involves providing high-quality instruction, guidance, and supervision to guests across various water-based activities, while upholding safety standards and operational discipline. The instructor contributes to delivering memorable guest experiences within a luxury marine tourism environment and supports daily operations and equipment readiness. Key Responsibilities Deliver water sports activities and instruction professionally and safely. Provide clear briefings and demonstrations to guests before all activities. Supervise guests during water-based activities to ensure safety and enjoyment. Support the Water Sports / Dive Center Manager with daily operational requirements. Maintain a professional appearance and uphold luxury hospitality standards. Assist with equipment setup, breakdown, and general operational readiness. Conduct water sports sessions including kayaking, paddle boarding, snorkeling, and wake activities. Ensure guests are properly fitted with equipment and briefed on safety procedures. Monitor environmental and weather conditions for safe activity delivery. Inspect and maintain all water sports equipment for safety and functionality. Report any equipment damage or safety concerns immediately. Provide exceptional guest service to ensure a high-quality experience. Assist in organizing daily activity schedules and guest allocations. Support inventory tracking and basic equipment maintenance records. Health, Safety, Environment & Quality Ensure safety is the highest priority in all water sports activities. Enforce compliance with all safety protocols, risk assessments, and emergency procedures. Conduct regular equipment checks to ensure all gear is safe for use. Promote environmental awareness and responsible use of marine environments. Adhere to company and regulatory safety standards at all times. Policies, Procedures & Reporting Follow all company policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and operational guidelines. Maintain accurate records of activities, incidents, and equipment usage as required. Report operational issues, guest concerns, or safety risks promptly to management. Work Environment This role operates within a luxury marine tourism and water sports environment. It requires flexibility to work outdoors, including weekends and during peak seasons. The position involves direct guest interaction and hands-on activity delivery, with exposure to varying marine and weather conditions. The Water Sport Instructor plays a key role in delivering safe, enjoyable, and memorable guest experiences.

2f63988bf14e55f2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رمال السواحل للمقاولات والصيانة عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المساعد الإداري مجموعة من المهام لدعم الرئيس المباشر والوحدة التنظيمية، وتشمل: تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، بالإضافة إلى فتح البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقًا لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة، والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات الخاصة. حفظ المعاملات والعناية بالملفات بطريقة منظمة تسهل عملية الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، وطباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن تتوفر في المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة البريد والمواعيد اليومية. المهارات المطلوبة يجب أن يمتلك المرشح الناجح المهارات التالية: مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية قوية. القدرة على التعامل مع المهام المتعددة وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية (مثل Microsoft Office). الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في إنجاز المهام. بيئة العمل يعمل المساعد الإداري في بيئة مكتبية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق يدعم العمليات اليومية للشركة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية.

2f9c10d9e5e1f8fe.description: Department: Business Development Employment Type: Full Time Location: KSA Reporting To: Abdulaziz Saja Description We're looking for an experienced Commercial Operations Specialist to own the technical and operational relationship between Tabby and our merchant and channel-partner ecosystem in KSA. This role sits at the center of our cross-functional engine — working across Risk, Integrations, BD and Account management to make sure merchants are set up correctly from day one and deliver a seamless payment experience across every touchpoint. You'll lead technical onboarding and delivery, operational coordination and product rollout execution, and you'll be the person who can sit in a room with both a merchant's engineering team and their commercial team and move the conversation forward. You are comfortable with payment flows, APIs and integrations, and equally comfortable translating them into plain business language. If you enjoy solving operational and technical problems at scale, owning processes end-to-end, and being the trusted bridge between technical and business stakeholders — this role is for you. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary operational and technical liaison between Tabby and partner merchants, coordinating closely with multiple internal teams like Product, Risk, Integrations and business development team. Own merchant and channel-partner technical onboarding end-to-end — documentation, testing coordination, progress tracking and timely activation, big focus on creating processes. Manage merchant data-enablement workflows, ensuring required data is captured, validated and aligned with risk and underwriting requirements. Lead technical-requirement negotiations with merchants — making sure they understand Tabby's requirements and protocols, while keeping the commercial objective on track. Drive cross-functional alignment on product rollouts: prepare merchant-facing materials, support GTM plans and ensure clean execution across teams. Analyze merchant performance and integration health, spot operational gaps and propose improvements. Own and improve internal SOPs and documentation so onboarding, integration and partner success are scalable and standardized. Support BD during technical discussions with merchants, ensuring commitments made in the sales cycle are actually deliverable against product and risk. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise Minimum 2-3 years of experience in Technical Account Management or Partner/Merchant Success or Solutions Delivery in Fintech/Payments Operations, Payments, E-commerce integrations, Technical Program Management, or a directly comparable yet relevant role. A technical foundation — either a technical degree (Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems) or a very strong demonstrable hands-on technical background in payments/integrations. Genuine, demonstrable understanding of payment flows, APIs, webhooks and checkout/plugin integrations. Strong written and spoken English and Arabic. Excellent cross-functional communication — able to translate technical concepts into actionable steps for non-technical people, and vice versa. Strong analytical, documentation and process-building skills. Job Benefits A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career. Participation in the company’s employee stock options program. Health Insurance Flexi Perks: A monetary benefit that gives you the freedom to use it as you choose—whether for health and well-being, education and professional development or travel needs!

2f8e1f87f5c2b881.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية ريسبونس بلس للخدمات الطبية عن كاتب رواتب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ الواجبات المحاسبية والإدارية المتعلقة بمعالجة كشوف الرواتب، بما في ذلك جمع بيانات حضور الموظفين وحساب الرواتب وتحديد المبالغ الإضافية أو الخصومات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية حفظ سجلات حضور الموظفين، الإجازات، وساعات العمل الإضافية، وإدخال البيانات بدقة في أنظمة كشوف الرواتب والمحاسبة. حساب الرواتب الشهرية، الخصومات، والتعويضات، واتخاذ القرارات المتعلقة بكشوف الرواتب، وإعداد بيانات أجور الموظفين. تجهيز مدفوعات الموظفين لضمان معالجتها في الوقت المناسب وبشكل دقيق. الرد على استفسارات الموظفين المتعلقة بقسائم الرواتب والتعويضات بوضوح واحترافية. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للشركة والتقيد بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات الرقمية بدقة عالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق ملتزم بتقديم خدمات طبية عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

الفرع والطبيب/ة المباشر. المساعدة في التوعية بأساليب التغذية العلاجية والغذاء الصحي. متابعة الأدوية والآثار الجانبية لها على المستفيد/ة وإعداد تقرير شهري بذلك. إعداد تقرير شهري للتدخلات التي تمت ونوعية الإصابات التي حدثت. متابعة إمدادات صناديق الإسعافات الأولية وصيانة المعدات الخاصة بالقسم الطبي والرفع لتوفيرها أو صيانتها. إعداد تقارير فصلية وسنوية عن الخدمات الطبية التي قُدمت للحالات داخل والتفاعل مع روح الفريق. الالتزام بساعات العمل. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: بكالوريوس تمريض. تصنيف هيئة التخصصات الصحية. المهارات الشخصية: القدرة على التعامل مع الحالات الطارئة وعمل الإجراء Maintain accurate maintenance logs, service records, and prepare detailed technical reports. Collaborate with engineering, operations, and maintenance teams on system upgrades, expansions, and water infrastructure projects. Support installation, commissioning, and testing of electrical equipment in water and wastewater facilities. Adhere to high safety standards while working on both energized and de-energized systems, especially in wet and hazardous environments. Technical diploma in Electrical Engineering or related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in high-voltage electrical maintenance, preferably in water utilities (treatment plants, pumping stations, or desalination). Strong knowledge of transformers, switchgear, and circuit breakers. Skilled in troubleshooting and maintenance of high-voltage equipment. Familiar with electrical codes and safety regulations in Saudi Arabia. Basic knowledge of SCADA and motor control systems is an advantage. Good problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team. Willing to work in Saudi Arabia and follow company policies.
